card.line: Sardis was a city in Asia Minor and the home of one of the seven churches that Jesus spoke to in the book of Revelation.

moments.title: A scroll for seven churches
moments.text: John hears a loud voice tell him to write what he sees and send it to seven churches. Sardis is one of them.

moments.title: Wake up, Sardis
moments.text: Jesus tells the church in Sardis that it has a reputation for being alive, yet it is dead. He tells them to wake up, strengthen what remains, remember what they heard, and repent.

moments.title: A few in white
moments.text: Jesus says a few people in Sardis have not soiled their garments. They are worthy and will walk with Him in white. He promises that the one who overcomes will be dressed in white, and He will never blot out his name from the Book of Life.
